_doc: Journeys J1-J7 of KIN-CONTINUE-003 as route-level walks of the REAL console (rsi/runtime/ux/walk.mjs). `steps` are declarative: goto <path> | click <text-regex or css> | fill <css> <text> | hover <text-regex or css> | key <chord> | place <picker-css> | enabled <text-regex or css> | shot <name>. Selectors are best-effort (zh+en); a selector prefixed with `?` is optional (empty-daemon / missing seed) and is recorded as skipped; any other missing or failed action is a hard failure. `place` opens the working-directory picker, chooses a listed place or a project root the daemon reports, and records `<journey>-<vp>-skipped-no-workdir` (a skip, not a failure) when there is genuinely nothing to choose. `enabled` asserts a control is usable without pressing it (a throwaway daemon has no fake agent, so starting a run would launch a real CLI); a disabled control is a hard failure unless the page names the missing prerequisite on screen. `paths` maps changed files to the journeys they can affect (first match wins; no match = all journeys). `viewports` are WxH.

J1.title: Phone: find yesterday's chat, continue, answer an approval

J2.title: Mac: search last week's chat, continue, change model/permission, look at the diff

J3.title: New chat on both surfaces: choose where it runs, type, reach a startable composer
